resources.string: Measure how fast Valkyr runs on this device
Times the library, the covers and the storage, and scrolls a list to count slow frames
performance, speed, benchmark, slow, lag, fps, frames, jank, stutter, startup, storage speed, ram, test

Runs a short self-test on this device and shows plain numbers: start-up, library queries, covers, the speed of your download folder and how smoothly a list scrolls. It usually takes under a minute. Nothing is sent anywhere; Share report hands the numbers to the share sheet and you choose where they go.
Writes one hidden 16 MB temporary file in your download folder, reads it back and deletes it. You see what it does before it starts.

This list scrolls by itself while the frames are counted. It uses simple rows, so it measures the device and the app\'s drawing, not your own library.
